Definition: from G1980; inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate":--the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.
BiblicalUsage: Episkope is visitation, oversight, inspection — the office of a bishop. Jerusalem knew not the time of her visitation; let his habitation be desolate, and his bishoprick let another take; if a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work; and the Gentiles shall glorify God in the day of visitation.
TheologicalSignificance: God visits to redeem and to reckon, and the bishop's office is to watch in the meantime, as one who will give account. I believe visitation is both mercy and judgment, and Jerusalem's failure to know the time of hers is the warning.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
